fichas.title: Questionnaire: Technical Basics
fichas.summary: A checklist of technical questions for establishing site and building requirements, including ground conditions, construction methods, insulation, building components, building services, transport systems, and waste handling.
uses: Assess subsoil, groundwater, foundations, and prior site development
Determine construction, material, insulation, and building-component requirements
Establish requirements for heating, water, drainage, gas, electricity, lighting, communications, lifts, and other services

fichas.title: Questionnaire: Design Documents
fichas.summary: A checklist for gathering and confirming the land, survey, utility, neighboring-building, building-application, and structural-calculation documents required for design and approval.
uses: Verify land registry information and planning documents
Confirm site levels and utility connections
Survey neighboring buildings and establish a benchmark
Determine building-application submission requirements and structural-checking procedures

fichas.title: Questionnaire: Tender Documents
fichas.summary: A checklist of logistics and procurement considerations for tendering, covering transport access, site roads, material storage, client-provided work, payment terms, and locally available building materials.
uses: Plan site roads and building-material storage
Establish payment terms and identify locally available materials

fichas.title: Questionnaire: Production Deadlines
fichas.summary: A checklist for setting deadlines and sequencing design and construction deliverables, from preliminary sketches and estimates through approvals, tendering, construction, completion, and final invoicing.
uses: Schedule design meetings and design stages
Plan estimates, approval submissions, and construction drawings
Set tender, contract-award, construction, completion, and invoicing milestones
